item.title: Moorhead City Council member considers candidacy for mayor
item.description: MOORHEAD (KVRR-KFGO) – A member of the Moorhead City Council is considering a run for mayor. Lisa Borgen says she will make an announcement in January. item.title: Former North Dakota Governor Allen Olson dies at 87
item.description: BISMARCK, N.D. (KVRR/KFGO) — Former North Dakota Governor Allen Olson has died.
